lines.x: There are no security risks in your room, and you can work with peace of mind. I'll stand guard at the door to help you turn down any unnecessary busywork.
The automatic door here is broken? Let me have a look. Hm… Haaaaah! Alright, Doctor, you're clear to go ahead and carry on with your work. I'll contact the maintenance staff.
You want to learn more about Minoan culture? I see, I'll put together a report for you. No, that's not information I can cover in just a few words. I must report it to you in detail.

Mercenaries must always update their pool of knowledge. If you can't keep up with the newest information, you could end up falling into the hands of enemies using the new methods, so there's absolutely no room to slack. I hope you understand this, Doctor. Doctor?

What did that Minoan girl in the garden do...? My head feels strangely empty, it's like I'm completely relaxed… This doesn't... seem normal to me. Doctor, I need to rest. I'm sorry, I'm out of service as your bodyguard for the time being…

Hoooooo, HAH! Looks like I'm in pretty good shape today, maybe it'll feel even better to exercise a bit with the reserve operators. Oh, it's Hell Week? Alright then, I'll have to bug Dobermann again and get her to find a place for me.

Corinia was built on the scales of merchants. Everyone there wants to squeeze as much as they can out of everyone else. But, people in the other city-states are a lot more interesting. I had all kinds of fun back when I was guarding them. The feeling was a lot like what I get with you, Doctor.

You need to train properly, Doctor. Not exactly, stretching and walks are light exercise. What I'm talking about is real training. It requires a full range of intense exercises, as well as a healthy diet to burn fat and build muscle. Oh, you're fine with that? Good, let me see your results then. Don't be like last time—Hey! I'm not done talking yet, get back here!

Finished that one too? Want one more bowl? No problem. This is the first time I've made a complete meal. Usually I just fill my belly with some rations and don't cook much. Here's the last portion. When you're done, you'll exercise just like we agreed. That's the whole reason I learned to do this.
Relaxing with a nap? Hehehe, this is a real luxury.
Hello, my new employer. I am Sideroca, a Corinian mercenary. My paperwork is all done. You can count on me.
These clips are only good for reference. Keep your eyes open in a real battle.
Each badge is a symbol of trust. I'll accept this.
I'll use my sword to cut down all threats to you. You have my word.
At your service.
I'll pass on your orders.
Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on the team.
We're starting.
Here.
Approaching the destination.
Let's see what you all can do.
This is where you stop.
Let's turn this around!
And stay down!
Hooaahh!
I'll show you how a Minoan fights!
Seeing how you command, I feel like my protection might be a little redundant.
What matters is you're alright. Let's get ready to head back.
You had to suffer through that because I was careless. I'm so, so sorry.
No matter what happens... I have to get the Doctor safely back to base…
It's too messy here. I'm going to have to give it a good cleaning.
What's the matter?
Doctor! This training was your idea! Why are you running off? Get back here!
Arknights.

Doctor, Happy the New Year. We can put your workout regimen on hold for today, but you still have to do some basic exercise. Also, I may have prepared a meal for you, but that's not an excuse to sit here eating the whole time—are you listening to me, Doctor? Doctor?
Nothing out of the ordinary!
I had this sapling brought all the way from Minos to celebrate your birthday. Find somewhere to plant it. I hope the joy of growth and new life will reach you in your thoughts.

The more I see of you, the more you unsettle me. Instructors Dur-nar and Dobermann are sharp, no doubt. They're no mercenaries, but still show such attentiveness to their employer. Doctor, I have a few questions I'd like to ask you, in order to better complete the missions you assign me...
